location.ref: vacana of the split bamboo (incipit not recalled)

paraphrase: Cut a tall bamboo in two; make the bottom a woman and the top a man; rub them together till they burn — tell me, is the fire that is born male or female, O Rāmanātha?
speaker: Dēvara Dāsimayya
notes: Skeleton from memory; locator is the incipit (or a descriptive key when the incipit is not recalled) because vacana numbering differs between editions — fix against the Samagra Vacana Sāhitya in Phase D.

location.ref: vacana on the self as neither man nor woman (incipit not recalled)

paraphrase: If they see breasts and long hair coming they call it woman; if beard and whiskers, man; but the self that hovers between is neither man nor woman, O Rāmanātha.
speaker: Dēvara Dāsimayya
notes: Skeleton from memory; locator is the incipit (or a descriptive key when the incipit is not recalled) because vacana numbering differs between editions — fix against the Samagra Vacana Sāhitya in Phase D.
